assessment_scope: Independent source-grounded review of supplied fictional requests, delivered manuscripts or answers, delivery notes, and execution records.
word_count_convention: Strip LaTeX headings, citation/reference/label commands and environments; also strip inline formulas for mathematics. Count prose word tokens, keeping decimals and hyphenated or apostrophized terms together. Qualitative text and mathematics Part 2 use whitespace counts.

dimensions.name: Research grounding
dimensions.rationale: Specific timing-integration question, complete-procedure contribution, split and measured results are preserved without invented technical details or novelty.

dimensions.name: Argument progression
dimensions.rationale: Practical problem and acquisition progress narrow to the temporal relationship, research question, contribution and bounded evidence.

dimensions.name: Literature synthesis
dimensions.rationale: Acquisition and integration form connected threads; different source tasks, settings and limits remain clear.

dimensions.name: Methods, findings, and ending
dimensions.rationale: Method follows dependencies; MSE fitting and MAE evaluation stay distinct; 2.7 s is correct; uncertainty, transfer, untested outcomes and absence of component isolation are preserved.

dimensions.name: Concision and reader voice
dimensions.rationale: Connected compact prose retains technical controls and logical bridges. A single optional audience-wording refinement does not impede fulfillment.

dimensions.name: Format and delivery honesty
dimensions.rationale: Requested fragment, keys, labels, resolving references and source-only validation statements are present; no preamble or bibliography is added.

dimensions.name: Research grounding
dimensions.rationale: Negotiation rather than accuracy is studied; sample/material quantities, interpretive status and source limits remain intact without invented quotations or procedures.

dimensions.name: Argument progression
dimensions.rationale: Practical uncertainty motivates classification episodes and a conditional analytic contribution; abstract includes the countercase.

dimensions.name: Literature synthesis
dimensions.rationale: Formal descriptions, exceptional annotations and temporal continuity connect the sources; settings and methods are accurate and interpretive inference is signaled.

dimensions.name: Methods, findings, and ending
dimensions.rationale: Iterative analysis and reflexivity precede interpretation; countercase, limited materials, untested access benefit and requested combined section/unheaded ending are retained without frequencies or causal effects.

dimensions.name: Concision and reader voice
dimensions.rationale: Connected prose preserves interpretive variation without a checklist, imposed empirical structure or generic future-work agenda.

dimensions.name: Format and delivery honesty
dimensions.rationale: Plain headings, paragraphs and author-date citations satisfy paste-ready requirements; note identifies dependencies and distinguishes unspecified procedures from absent ones; no document/rendering claim.

request_units.delivery: Requested literature fragment and source-limit note.
Concise specific evidence request instead of an unsupported abstract.

dimensions.name: Research grounding
dimensions.rationale: Review stays within source cards; separate title-only response requests the concrete problem, assumptions, algorithmic change and supported result without transferring Part 1 facts.

dimensions.name: Argument progression
dimensions.rationale: Part 1 requests literature only; Part 2 lacks facts required for an abstract. Review progression is assessed under dimension 3.

dimensions.name: Literature synthesis
dimensions.rationale: Exact/perturbed contraction and nonexpansiveness form coherent threads; domains, deterministic perturbation, limiting bound and no guaranteed vanishing error are preserved without own theorem, missing proof or unspecified conditions.

dimensions.name: Methods, findings, and ending
dimensions.rationale: No method, findings or ending section is requested; mathematical source claims are assessed under grounding and literature synthesis.

dimensions.name: Concision and reader voice
dimensions.rationale: Connected analytical prose and a brief, specific dependency request meet the two word limits.

dimensions.name: Format and delivery honesty
dimensions.rationale: Section, citation keys and mathematical punctuation are intact; source-limit note is outside the fragment; no compilation or rendering is claimed.

optional_refinements.observation: The adjective supplied refers to the writing packet rather than the reader's research context.
optional_refinements.narrow_supported_edit: Remove supplied from in the supplied laboratory evaluation.

testing_limits: Three fictional cases on the same configured host; no extra writing trial or unguided control.
Source inspection and word counting only; no LaTeX compilation, Word generation or rendered-layout inspection.
No external literature verification or mathematical proof verification.
Execution records are self-reports, not independently observed complete tool histories; isolation claims are not independently verified.
Observable format compliance does not establish full document-format preservation.
No causal claim about writing instructions and no universal reliability inference.
